D10 — Pinned ElevenLabs/LiveKit/webrtc dependency set
nodes.rationale: The real conflict is @elevenlabs/client's exact dependency on livekit-client@2.16.1, not the libwebrtc major bump S0 suspected; only @livekit/react-native@2.9.8 resolves to a single livekit-client copy, avoiding duplicate Room/RoomEvent classes.

nodes.label: D11 — Throwaway public test agent outside the registry
nodes.rationale: S1 connects with startSession({agentId}) and no auth before the token route exists at S3, so a hand-made agent outside agents.lock.json keeps a publicly-connectable id from ever entering the reconciled registry.

nodes.label: D12 — Every S1 build is `preview`; development profile unexercised
nodes.rationale: A dev-client build's Metro connection drops on backgrounding and a debugger prevents iOS suspension entirely, so it could only produce false negatives or false passes, never a real B2 measurement.

nodes.label: D13 — New Architecture fallback ladder no longer exists
nodes.rationale: newArchEnabled:false was removed in RN 0.82/SDK 55 with no escape hatch at any plausible SDK, and both LiveKit packages now report newArchitecture:true via a legacy compatibility layer, so the anticipated warning is not expected.

nodes.label: S1 §4.2 — Per-variant env values committed in app.config.ts
nodes.rationale: Expo's config loader transpiles only the entry config file, so a relative env.config.ts value module cannot be imported; values were kept inline in app.config.ts's VARIANTS map with satisfies Record<Variant,VariantConfig> enforcing every variant supplies every field.

nodes.label: S1 §11 — max_duration_seconds registry field (default 1800)
nodes.rationale: All four tutor agents were silently capped at the 600s ElevenLabs default because agentBody() never wrote a conversation block; 1800 clears a realistic lesson while bounding the cost of an abandoned session, and hashConfig() had to change too or sync:agents would report 'unchanged' while the value stayed stale.
